mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_rule (name, source_filter, service_code_filter, resource_filter, severity_filter, tag_filter, channels, enabled) VALUES (#{name}, #{sourceFilter}, #{serviceCodeFilter}, #{resourceFilter}, #{severityFilter}, #{tagFilter}, #{channels}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_rule SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
